description: This file is a Lua script for a Pandoc filter that replaces placeholders in document elements (like strings, links, code, and code blocks) with corresponding variable values stored in metadata.

methods.name: escape_pattern
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a pattern string to be used in gsub substitutions.

methods.name: get_vars
methods.description: Populates local tables with variables extracted from document metadata for later replacements.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces inline string elements with corresponding variable values if they exist.

methods.name: replace_link
methods.description: Replaces patterns in link targets based on stored string variables.

methods.name: replace_code
methods.description: Replaces patterns in inline code text based on stored string variables.

methods.name: replace_code_block
methods.description: Replaces patterns in code block text based on stored string variables.

methods.name: Pandoc
methods.description: Main filter function invoked by Pandoc; applies variable replacement to document elements.
